programs.title: Built on Sand and Sea: Dunhuang and Venice Ep.4
programs.desc: This documentary features Dunhuang and Venice as dual protagonists against the epic backdrop of the Silk Road. Through their founding stories, commercial networks, artistic traditions, and heritage preservation efforts, it reveals how these cities became stages where humanity created material and spiritual civilizations amid desert sands and ocean waves鈥攁nd where diverse cultures collided, fused, and ultimately flourished.

programs.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programs.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou鈥檚 traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programs.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programs.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programs.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programs.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programs.title: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun
programs.desc: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness. This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat. Witness the subtle power and intellectual depth of this sophisticated fighting system.

programs.title: Wild Wonders Ep.1
programs.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.
